page.layout: One column of running text, with three footnotes below it in smaller type. Running head at top left, page number at top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: quidquid petiisti, mitte de comitatu tuo duos homines probos, timentes Deum; veraces {l} Sapientes & intelligentes & doctos, & vide, quid dixerit tibi anima tua, & quod placuerit in oculis tuis ex aliquo artificio pretioso. Mitte illud cum eis in domum Dei Israel ad in scriptionem sacram & ad nomen magnum, sacerdotesque magnos munus, votumque & spontaneam oblationem Prophetis sanctis Eleazaro & Ithamar, & Phinees & Josuæ filio Nun, & Calebo filio Jephone & Josepho Patri nostro {m} filio fructificanti, super quos pax in æternum, omnes enim sepulti sunt in ditione urbis Sichem, deferunturq; ad eos vota & oblationes spontaneæ ex omni urbe & ex omnibus familiis; hoc si feceris, cognoscemus, quod Dominum timeas, & in eum credas, & in Mosem Prophetam ejus, & in legem scripturæ ejus, & quod ames populum ejus filios Israel; accidet autem, si feceris, quemadmodum dico, ut benedicat tibi Dominus Deus tuus {n} Dabisque pecuniam

page.notes: The line ending "defe-runturq;" keeps the printed abbreviation q; (for -que). The running text runs on from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The footnote letters (l), (m), (n) are printed as parentheses in the text and are given here as curly-brace marks. Long s is printed as a plain s throughout. The signature "G 4" is slightly unclear in the scan.
